description: Screen a business acquisition against baseline SBA 7(a) requirements: ownership citizenship, loan size, for-profit US operation, size standard, change of ownership, existing SBA debt, equity injection, seller note standby and credit elsewhere. Returns each rule as pass, review or constraint, with its source and verification status. This is a screen, not an eligibility finding: most rules route to review, and no answer produces "eligible". Use when the user asks whether an SBA loan is an option.

change-of-ownership.description: Is this a complete change of ownership — the buyer acquiring 100% of the business? Leave out when the user has not said.

citizenship.description: Is every individual owner, direct or indirect, a US citizen or US national with their principal residence in the United States, its territories or possessions? Leave out when the user has not said.

credit-elsewhere.description: Could the buyer obtain this financing on reasonable terms without an SBA guaranty? Leave out when the user has not said.

equity-injection.description: Is the required equity injection available as the buyer’s own cash? Leave out when the user has not said.

existing-sba-debt.description: Does the buyer, or any affiliate, already have an SBA loan outstanding? Leave out when the user has not said.

for-profit-us.description: Is the target an operating, for-profit business located in the United States? Leave out when the user has not said.

loan-amount.description: How much 7(a) principal would you be requesting? In US dollars.

seller-note-standby.description: Does the structure rely on a seller note counting toward the equity injection? Leave out when the user has not said.

size-standard.description: Does the target meet the SBA size standard for its industry? Leave out when the user has not said.

name: screen_sba_eligibility
title: Screen baseline SBA 7(a) eligibility
